label: At GO after a rewarded S1 visit, fading later in the episode.
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == -1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == -1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief > 0.5) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state==2) * ep_dec
explanation: Active only at GO. Magnitude is set by the last trial: high (about +0.45 over the rest) when the previous trial reached S1 and was rewarded (either a1 common or a2 rare), near zero after any S2 outcome or an unrewarded S1. The size shrinks over the episode (S1 x ep_dec term, negative weight), which also matches the falling GO timing baseline. On the window first trial, where the last trial is not in the window, the observer belief log-odds for S1 takes its place. So it reads as an S1-good / win-stay-on-S1 signal at choice time. The free fit (belief magnitude within S1-rewarded trials, a stronger-belief indicator, S2 x ep_dec) adds only about 0.03 on dev. Not explained: large episode-to-episode differences in amplitude (about 1.2 versus a predicted 0.45 in long S1-rewarded streaks), which the graded belief does not capture.

issues: Running misses on the recorded short form leaves a large systematic error class. GO steps after every S2 outcome are over-predicted: a1 S2 u -0.129, a2 S2 u -0.123, a1 S2 r -0.104, a2 S2 r -0.103. The mean GO error is -0.042. The timing baseline gives every GO step a positive mean, and nothing in the short form pulls it back to zero after an S2 visit. The explanation says the feature is 'near zero after any S2 outcome', but the recorded fit does not predict that.

The third term, (phase==GO)*(prev_state==-1)*belief_lo (first trial of the window), is close to a fitted correction and adds little. Swapping it for (phase==GO)*(prev_state==2) raises the test R^2 beyond timing from 0.457 to 0.507. That is higher than the 0.489 reported for the free fit. In misses on the new form, every phase x previous-trial error is within +-0.07; the largest is GO after a2 S1 r at +0.068.

The label leaves out the S2 contrast, which is exactly where the recorded form fails. The 'fades later in the episode' claim holds on test. Dropping the S1 x ep_dec term costs about 0.07 (0.507 -> 0.440). Dropping the S2 term costs about 0.09 (0.507 -> 0.416).

Still not explained: large differences in amplitude within S1-rewarded streaks (about 1.0-1.3 actual against about 0.45 predicted). Rare-rewarded S1 trials (a2 S1 r) run slightly higher than common ones (residual +0.356 vs +0.277), and the short form does not capture this.
